note: Eighth company, picked deliberately (at the user's suggestion) as another structurally complex real deal, and specifically as a chance to investigate the DIVESTED_BUSINESS event type -- which, this pass discovered, had NEVER been implemented in the extractor code at all (see CONTEXT_EVENT_EXTRACTION_ATT.md). AT&T's WarnerMedia separation is a Reverse Morris Trust transaction: a tax-structured spin-off (AT&T transfers WarnerMedia to a new subsidiary, 'Spinco'/Magallanes, Inc., then distributes Spinco's shares to AT&T stockholders) immediately followed by a merger of that spun-off entity into Discovery -- a fundamentally different mechanism from a direct asset sale (Disney/Sinclair's 'agreed to sell X's interests in Y to Buyer' shape, which the newly-built DIVESTED_BUSINESS pattern was validated against and correctly recalls). AT&T's Reverse-Morris-Trust phrasing does NOT match that pattern and is not expected to -- confirmed directly, not assumed. Scoped to the WarnerMedia/Discovery transaction only (announced 2021-05-17, closed 2022-04-08); AT&T's other real divestitures (DirecTV to TPG, 2021 and again fully in 2024-2025) and acquisitions (DirecTV 2015, Time Warner 2018, US Cellular spectrum 2024) are out of scope for this pass.
